fusions.name: Stampeding Broadsheets
fusions.desc: Sends a charge of folded broadsheets 5 tiles ahead in a cone that deals 13 damage to everything in it and knocks each target 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Galloping Effigy
fusions.desc: Hurls a folded effigy that deals 26 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles, and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Offering Steed
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to fold a steed that fights beside you for 12 seconds, trampling an enemy within 2 tiles for 5 damage every second.

fusions.name: Turnpike Charter
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 10% more damage.
